scope: Completed source and commercial-offer review for 44 sensor ICs, 20 communication/interface ICs and five TI/Vishay optical sensors. Hall/angle and the other optical additions are owned by separate audits; the planned new-radio batch was removed from scope.
policy: Commercial listing observations establish an available offer, not a sales ranking or manufacturer lifecycle guarantee. All generated footprints are reference carriers and all generated 3D geometry is approximate.

Native top-mount carrier uses selected Y alignment and copper sizes; it is not the exact manufacturer production pattern.

validation.physicalChecks: All contacts have unique physical anchors, functions, electrical types and matching native pad numbers. Analytic reference-copper checks find no overlapping pads.
validation.visualReview: Labeled and unlabeled drawings reviewed in Chrome galleries, including optical windows, clockwise BME numbering, TO-92 flat sides and dense LGA contacts. Source views compared to retained manufacturer PDF pages.
validation.nativeLimitations: All footprints remain FP:R selected reference carriers; the generated WRL body is approximate (3D:A). Successful native import does not establish production geometry accuracy.
